correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed the actual two-copy quadratic polynomial map (b,c)->(xb+yc,xb²+yc²). For every xy(x+y)≠0, (x+y)w−v²=xy(b−c)². For odd q, with each fixed v, the square map has one zero and (q−1)/2 double preimages: exactly q fibers of cardinality 1 and q(q−1)/2 of cardinality 2. In characteristic 2 squaring is a bijection of every finite field, yielding q² singleton fibers. There are (q−1)(q−2) good (x,y). Substitution into the actual source Eq. (16), including its q^(−6) normalization, gives the claimed finite-q formulas and limiting 1/2 and 1. Separate independently written enumeration checked odd primes 3,5,7 and F4, while the symbolic argument covers all prime powers; it does not claim optimal discrimination or q=2 success.
